translation: If there is congested swelling and pain, one should administer Zhenggu Zijin Dan (Bone-Setting Purple-Gold Pill, 正骨紫金丹) internally and apply Wanling Gao (Myriad-Efficacy Plaster, 萬靈膏) externally. <ins>Wanling Gao</ins> <ins>Zhenggu Zijin Dan</ins> (both seen in the injury of the vertex bone).
